name: coldchain-box-system
description: 冷链保温箱清洗批次与门店交接系统（NestJS + Prisma + SQLite + React）

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:push && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm -w backend run start:dev" "npm -w frontend run dev"
scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run dev
